name: Update Unit

pathParams.name: unitId
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the unit to update

attributes.name: Name
attributes.description: The unit name as displayed in the AppFolio Property Manager

attributes.name: Bathrooms
attributes.description: The number of desired bathrooms

attributes.name: Bedrooms
attributes.description: The number of desired bedrooms

attributes.name: SquareFeet
attributes.description: The size of the unit in square feet

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: A brief, informative description of the unit

attributes.name: ListedMarketRent
attributes.description: The rent per month as listed on the market

attributes.name: ListedRent
attributes.description: The rent per month as listed on the market. This value reflects either the market rent or the advertised rent, depending on whether "Use Market Rent On Ads" is enabled in AppFolio Property Manager.

attributes.name: MarketRent
attributes.description: The unit's base market rent, representing its estimated fair market value based on current market conditions and comparable properties. It does not include advertised adjustments or amenity fees. This value directly updates the unit's market rent unless overridden by a configured unit type.

attributes.name: AdvertiseUsingListedMarketRent
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not to use the listed market rent as the advertised rent. Passing in null will result in no change.

attributes.name: CatsAllowed
attributes.description: The unit's cat policy. Enum: "Yes" "No" or null

attributes.name: DogsAllowed
attributes.description: The unit's dog policy. Enum: "Large & Small" "Small Only" "No" or null

attributes.name: CustomFields
attributes.description: The custom fields for the associated entity. Each key is a CustomFieldId and value is the new value to set. Set to null to clear; use empty array [] or empty string "" for array-type fields.

attributes.name: CustomFieldId
attributes.description: The value of the CustomField to update. Type must match the type configured for the CustomField at creation.

attributes.name: Address1
attributes.description: The primary street address of the unit

attributes.name: Address2
attributes.description: Additional street address information pertaining to the unit

attributes.name: City
attributes.description: The city where the unit is located

attributes.name: State
attributes.description: The state where the unit is located

attributes.name: Zip
attributes.description: The zip code where the unit is located

attributes.name: MaintenanceNotes
attributes.description: A brief informative message about the unit's maintenance

attributes.name: MarketingTitle
attributes.description: The title of the listing for syndication

attributes.name: MarketingDescription
attributes.description: A description of the listing for syndication

attributes.name: NonRevenue
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the unit is rentable and is a model unit, office or other non revenue unit

attributes.name: Deposit
attributes.description: The security deposit amount

attributes.name: ApplicationFee
attributes.description: The application fee amount

attributes.name: RentReady
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the unit is ready to be occupied by a tenant

attributes.name: Tags
attributes.description: User-defined tag(s) that categorize the unit. Providing an array of valid strings will overwrite all existing tags. Passing in an empty array [] or an array of empty strings will clear all existing tags. Passing in null will result in no change.

attributes.name: LastInspectedDate
attributes.description: The date the unit was last inspected

attributes.name: YouTubeURL
attributes.description: The URL of the YouTube video for the listing(s)

attributes.name: PostedToInternet
attributes.description: Sets whether to post the unit to third-party listings pages. Set to true to display and accept applications and false to remove the listing.

attributes.name: PostedToWebsite
attributes.description: Sets whether to post the unit to the AppFolio listings page. Set to true to display and accept applications and false to remove the listing.

attributes.name: AvailableOn
attributes.description: The date upon which the unit can be leased. The date must be within three years of today's date

attributes.name: ReadyForShowingOn
attributes.description: The date upon which the unit is ready for showing

attributes.name: UnitTypeId
attributes.description: When present, the unit type can dictate fields like bedrooms, bathrooms, sq. feet, etc. Attempting to update a Unit with values that conflict with the Unit Type will cause an error.

attributes.name: HvacFilters
attributes.description: Array containing data about a unit's HVAC filters

attributes.name: Length
attributes.description: The length of the HVAC filter

attributes.name: Width
attributes.description: The width of the HVAC filter

attributes.name: Thickness
attributes.description: The thickness of the HVAC filter

attributes.name: Quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the HVAC filter

attributes.name: Model
attributes.description: The model of the HVAC filter

attributes.name: Brand
attributes.description: The brand of the HVAC filter

attributes.name: HvacDetail
attributes.description: The HVAC details of the unit

attributes.name: ConfirmedNoFiltersNeeded
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the unit does not require HVAC filters

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the updated unit
